human_economic_burden.boundary: UNEP-assessed annual remediation financing requirement; not observed monetary damage or a financing shortfall.

transformations.formula: Normalize the UNEP-assessed degraded share and annual remediation financing requirement through named fixed impact ranges.
Current drained-or-degraded share divided by the atlas-reported annual intact-peatland destruction rate; capped through the 100-year-equivalent extreme anchor.
177 source-reported countries with peatlands / 193 UN Member States.

receipts.uncertainty: Global peatland mapping and condition inventories remain incomplete. Degraded-area share, annual hotspot loss, emissions attribution, financing requirements and national peatland presence have different assessment years and methods. Required investment is a remediation requirement, not observed economic damage.
receipts.freshness: UNEP 2022 assessment with 2024 hotspot-atlas extent and annual-loss update; snapshot captured 2026-07-31T16:51:27.997Z.

higher_priority_failures: The assessment and atlas provide benchmark totals rather than at least 20 complete annual or 60 monthly global observations.
